API reference

API Documentation

Keep docs, browsable endpoints and admin workflows connected so the scaffold feels like one product rather than a collection of disconnected tools.

Quick start

1. Run migrations and seed the example book data.

2. Visit the browsable API at /api/v1/.

3. Use Django admin to inspect or adjust the same records.

Anonymous callers get read access only. Sign in at /api-auth/login/ and the create, edit and delete forms appear on every endpoint.

Included routes

GET /api/v1/books/
GET /api/v1/books/recent/
UI /{{ app_name }}/
AUTH /api-auth/login/
